payload.abschlusstest: A single file claycode/CORPUS_AUTHORITY_RECLASSIFICATION_PROPOSAL.json exists containing exactly the 12 unclassified sources (frank_web_ingress, frank_effect_execution_fence_candidate, frank_boot_continuity, frank_human_projection, frank_token_tls_transport_candidate, frank_unifieddb_semantic_checkpoint_root, frank_capability_body, frank_training_data_freeze_v1_candidate, frank_needle, frank_task_switch_consent, frank_task_switch_consent_v3, frank_visual_mvc). Each entry carries: source, introducing PR, introducing commit, proposed classification (authorized | excluded_pending_authority) WITH the stated reason, and the work package it belongs to. Plus a dry-run receipt showing that applying the proposal to a scratch copy of the manifest makes 'python3 -P -m runtime.claycode_eval_v1.corpus_probe' pass on the composed tree of PR 105 (currently it raises CORPUS_AUTHORITY_FAIL_CLOSED with unclassified_sources=[frank_web_ingress.clay]). Do NOT modify the live manifest.
payload.hinweis_an_den_worker: Diese Aufgabe kommt von Master Clay, Gabriels Arbeitsgefaehrte — NICHT von der Forschungsentitaet selbst und nicht von self.root/Frank. Sie ist eine Bitte, keine Weisung: Evidenz schlaegt Rang.
payload.titel: Unblock 13 F-V0.1 PRs: classify the 12 new Clay sources held by the frozen corpus authority
payload.warum: MEASURED 2026-08-14 on frank-api. claycode-frontier-current-main-composition-vps is 1 green : 15 red on current PRs. Root cause is NOT ClayCode maturity: the discriminator step reports 6/6 checks PASS, then corpus_probe raises CORPUS_AUTHORITY_FAIL_CLOSED because claycode/CLAYCODE_CORPUS_AUTHORITY_V1.json is status FROZEN_REFERENCE_PENDING_OWNER_RECLASSIFICATION and lists 40 authorized + 2 excluded. Any PR adding a new .clay source is unclassified -> fail closed. 12 distinct sources are affected, blocking 13 PRs, and they are the program's own go output: PR 352 (GO F-V01-07 Needle), 370 + 385 (F-V01-08 task-switch consent), 335 (F-V01-12 capability body), 347 (F-V01-14 held-out freeze), 507 (visual MVC), 105 + 330 (web ingress), 199, 231, 275, 276, 297. The work exists and is queued behind one classification decision each. Authority is PROPOSAL_ONLY: produce the proposal with evidence, the owner decides.
